f.title: Submit a post-registration surveillance (pharmacovigilance) plan with the vaccine registration application
f.statement: At the time of registration, the applicant must submit a post-registration surveillance plan for the vaccine; the registration dossier index (Annex II, item 13) lists it as the 'Plan de Farmacovigilancia'.
f.clause: Annex I, 6. Pharmacovigilance of vaccines; Annex II, B.13 Pharmacovigilance plan
f.applicability: Argentina; Disposición ANMAT 705/2005 (Buenos Aires, 7 Feb 2005): requirements and documentation for applications to register vaccines in the Registro de Especialidades Medicinales (REM). Only the pharmacovigilance and safety-relevant parts are curated (CMC, GMP, preclinical and lot-release requirements are out of scope). Applies to all vaccines (novel and conventional).

rows.actor: Applicant / registration holder of a vaccine
rows.deadline: At the time of registration (with the application)
rows.quote:
6.- Farmacovigilancia de Vacunas
Al momento del registro deberá presentarse un plan de vigilancia post registro
rows.location: Annex I, 6. Pharmacovigilance of vaccines; Annex II, B.13 Pharmacovigilance plan
rows.review_note: Review: deberá = shall; Mandatory. In the capture the sentence runs straight into the GLOSARIO heading; the quote stops before it. Annex II B.13 'PLAN DE FARMACOVIGILANCIA' confirms the dossier item. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: 6.- Pharmacovigilance of Vaccines. At the time of registration, a post-registration surveillance plan shall be submitted.

f.title: Justify in the dossier the safety information (warnings, precautions, contraindications, adverse reactions, interactions) proposed for the package leaflet
f.statement: The preclinical-clinical part of the vaccine registration dossier must include the safety information that justifies the restrictions of use (warnings, precautions, contraindications, adverse reactions and interactions) to be included in the package leaflets.
f.applicability: Argentina; Disposición ANMAT 705/2005 (Buenos Aires, 7 Feb 2005): requirements and documentation for applications to register vaccines in the Registro de Especialidades Medicinales (REM). Only the pharmacovigilance and safety-relevant parts are curated (CMC, GMP, preclinical and lot-release requirements are out of scope).

rows.quote:
Se deberá incluir la siguiente información:
Exposición Sumaria: resumen de la justificación técnica, científica y sanitaria por la cual el producto
constituye una vacuna segura y eficaz y la justificación de la inclusión de cada uno de los
ingredientes activos, aditivos y excipientes en la fórmula.
Informe del Experto: informe elaborado por uno o más expertos en el que describan los aspectos
químico-farmacéuticos, preclínicos y clínicos del producto.
Los fundamentos que justifiquen: Condiciones de administración: indicaciones, posología, vías de
administración y modo de uso que se incluirán en los prospectos.
Las informaciones de seguridad que justifiquen Restricciones de uso: advertencias, precauciones,
contraindicaciones, reacciones adversas e interacciones que se incluirán en los prospectos.
rows.review_note: Review: 'Se deberá incluir' = shall be included; Mandatory. Only the safety-information item is curated; the summary statement and expert report are registration content. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: The following information shall be included: Summary statement: summary of the technical, scientific and health justification for which the product constitutes a safe and effective vaccine and justification of the inclusion of each of the active ingredients, additives and excipients in the formula. Expert report: report prepared by one or more experts describing the chemical-pharmaceutical, preclinical and clinical aspects of the product. The grounds justifying: Conditions of administration: indications, posology, routes of administration and method of use that will be included in the leaflets. The safety information justifying Restrictions of use: warnings, precautions, contraindications, adverse reactions and interactions that will be included in the leaflets.

f.title: Provide safety data for single and repeated doses, covering local reactions at the administration site and systemic reactions (novel vaccines)
f.statement: For novel vaccines, the clinical safety data submitted must relate to single and repeated dose administration and cover both local reactions at the site of administration and systemic reactions.
f.clause: Annex I, 3.2.a Clinical information - novel vaccines
f.applicability: Argentina; Disposición ANMAT 705/2005 (Buenos Aires, 7 Feb 2005): requirements and documentation for applications to register vaccines in the Registro de Especialidades Medicinales (REM). Only the pharmacovigilance and safety-relevant parts are curated (CMC, GMP, preclinical and lot-release requirements are out of scope). Novel (innovative) vaccines: Phase I, II and III studies required.

rows.actor: Applicant for registration of a novel vaccine
rows.quote:
Los datos de seguridad deberán estar relacionados con la administración de dosis simples y
repetidas, tanto en el ámbito local en el sitio de la administración como reacciones sistémicas.
rows.location: Annex I, 3.2.a Clinical information - novel vaccines
rows.review_note: Review: deberán = shall; Mandatory. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: The safety data shall relate to the administration of single and repeated doses, both locally at the site of administration and as systemic reactions.

f.title: For new combination vaccines, evaluate immunological interference and adverse effects versus separate administration of the antigens
f.statement: For new combination vaccines, the applicant must evaluate the possible immunological interference between the antigens, the adverse effects compared with individual administration of the antigens, and possible interference with vaccines recommended in the same period for a given population.
f.clause: Annex I, 3.2.a Clinical information - novel vaccines
f.applicability: Argentina; Disposición ANMAT 705/2005 (Buenos Aires, 7 Feb 2005): requirements and documentation for applications to register vaccines in the Registro de Especialidades Medicinales (REM). Only the pharmacovigilance and safety-relevant parts are curated (CMC, GMP, preclinical and lot-release requirements are out of scope).

rows.actor: Applicant for registration of a new combination vaccine
rows.quote:
En el caso de nuevas vacunas combinadas se deberá evaluar la posible interferencia inmunológica
entre los antígenos, los efectos adversos en relación con la administración individual de los
antígenos y la posible interferencia con vacunas cuya administración esté recomendada en el
mismo período de tiempo en una población en particular.
rows.location: Annex I, 3.2.a Clinical information - novel vaccines
rows.review_note: Review: 'se deberá evaluar' = shall be evaluated; Mandatory. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: In the case of new combination vaccines, the possible immunological interference between the antigens, the adverse effects in relation to the individual administration of the antigens and the possible interference with vaccines whose administration is recommended in the same period of time in a particular population shall be evaluated.

f.title: Conduct vaccine clinical trials under GCP; for trials in Argentina attach the ANMAT authorisations and the approved final study report
f.statement: Clinical trials of vaccines and the information derived from them must comply with internationally accepted Good Clinical Practice. For trials conducted in Argentina, the application must attach the authorisations granted under Disposición ANMAT 5330/97 (and amendments) and the final study report approved by ANMAT.
f.clause: Annex I, 3.2.a Clinical information - novel vaccines
f.legal_basis: Ley 16.463; Decreto 150/92; Disposición ANMAT 705/2005; Disposición ANMAT 5330/97
f.applicability: Argentina; Disposición ANMAT 705/2005 (Buenos Aires, 7 Feb 2005): requirements and documentation for applications to register vaccines in the Registro de Especialidades Medicinales (REM). Only the pharmacovigilance and safety-relevant parts are curated (CMC, GMP, preclinical and lot-release requirements are out of scope).

rows.actor: Applicant for vaccine registration (sponsor of the supporting trials)
rows.quote:
Los ensayos
clínicos y las informaciones que de ellos deriven deberán cumplir con las Buenas Prácticas Clínicas
internacionalmente aceptadas. En caso de ensayos realizados en la Argentina deberán adjuntarse
las autorizaciones según la Disposición ANMAT 5330/97 y sus modificatorias y el informe final del
estudio aprobado por la ANMAT.
rows.location: Annex I, 3.2.a Clinical information - novel vaccines
rows.review_note: Review: deberán = shall; Mandatory. Kept for the safety-in-clinical-trials scope (GCP, final report). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: Clinical trials and the information derived from them shall comply with internationally accepted Good Clinical Practice. In the case of trials conducted in Argentina, the authorisations under ANMAT Disposition 5330/97 and its amendments and the final study report approved by ANMAT shall be attached.

f.title: For pregnant women and women of child-bearing potential, submit fetal safety data and exclude embryo-fetal and perinatal toxicity risk
f.statement: For vaccines intended for pregnant women, the applicant must present the results of the evaluation of fetal safety after administration and of the immune response. For vaccines that may be used in women of reproductive age, the risk of embryo-fetal and perinatal toxicity must be reasonably excluded by clinical and/or epidemiological documentation with data on exposure to the pathogen or related vaccines.
f.clause: Annex I, 3.1.a Preclinical information - novel vaccines
f.applicability: Argentina; Disposición ANMAT 705/2005 (Buenos Aires, 7 Feb 2005): requirements and documentation for applications to register vaccines in the Registro de Especialidades Medicinales (REM). Only the pharmacovigilance and safety-relevant parts are curated (CMC, GMP, preclinical and lot-release requirements are out of scope). Novel vaccines intended for pregnant women or usable in women of reproductive age.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Applicant for registration of a novel vaccine
rows.quote:
En el caso de vacunas que se pretendan administrar a embarazadas, se presentará los resultados
de la evaluación de la seguridad del feto frente a la administración de la vacuna y la respuesta
inmunológica producida.
Para vacunas que pueden ser utilizadas en mujeres en edad reproductiva el riesgo de toxicidad
embriofetal y perinatal debe ser razonablemente excluido mediante documentación clínica y/o
epidemiológica con datos sobre exposición al agente patógeno o vacunas relacionadas.
rows.location: Annex I, 3.1.a Preclinical information - novel vaccines
rows.review_note: Review: 'se presentará' / 'debe ser ... excluido' = shall / must; Mandatory. Kept as pregnancy safety evidence feeding the RMP; other preclinical toxicology requirements are not curated. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed; 88 because the section is preclinical.
rows.quote_en: In the case of vaccines intended to be administered to pregnant women, the results of the evaluation of fetal safety following administration of the vaccine and of the immune response produced shall be presented. For vaccines that may be used in women of reproductive age, the risk of embryo-fetal and perinatal toxicity must be reasonably excluded by means of clinical and/or epidemiological documentation with data on exposure to the pathogen or related vaccines.
